design.site_summary: A shaded microclimate balcony featuring verified non-toxic pet-safe foliage for an inquisitive cat named Felix.
design.layout_strategy: A three-tiered vertical structure featuring hanging plants at eye level, upright perennials at mid height against the wall, and a low grazing ground layer along the balcony edge easily accessible by Felix.
design.combination_logic: These plants combine contrasting bright indirect light foliage with varied textures, providing a lush visual screen that changes subtly through the seasons without posing any danger to pets.

zones.placement: on the east-facing balcony edge floor, 3 h of morning sun, easily reachable by Felix.

plants.why: Provides a low ground-level herb texture that Felix can safely interact with.
plants.role_in_combination: Contributes delicate blue flowers and soft textural foliage at the front edge.

maintenance: Water twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn.
Prune spent flower stems to encourage fresh growth.

zones.placement: against the east wall, container level, knee to waist height, sheltered from afternoon heat.

plants.why: Brings striking red spathes and glossy dark leaves to the mid layer.
plants.role_in_combination: Provides height contrast and vibrant color accents against the green background.

maintenance: Water thoroughly when top inch of soil is dry.
Mist foliage weekly to maintain humidity.
Wipe leaves with a damp cloth monthly.

zones.placement: suspended from the top railing above eye level, receiving bright indirect light.

plants.why: Offers cascading trailing foliage that softens the hard edges of the railing.
plants.role_in_combination: Adds rich textural contrast and hanging lines that balance the upright mid-layer plants.

maintenance: Check moisture daily in peak summer.
Prune back leggy stems after flowering.
Repot every spring into fresh draining mix.

care_instructions.task: Watering all containers thoroughly until drainage appears
care_instructions.frequency: twice a week in summer, weekly in spring and autumn

care_instructions.task: Applying balanced liquid fertilizer to support active growth
Inspecting foliage for pests and removing dead debris

care_cautions: Overwatering in the hanging baskets containing Begonia spp. can lead to root rot.
The Balcony Edge Grazing Zone must be monitored to prevent soil compaction from Felix stepping on the pot.
design.pet_safety_note: This entire planting design is carefully selected to ensure absolute safety for your cat Felix, avoiding toxic oxalate-rich species in accessible areas.
